messages:
alex: Heads-up — after autotune v3 landed (PR #4231) I'm seeing a 12-18% tail-latency regression on GQA paths for seq_len=2048 on A100s. Can people toss quick perf numbers?

maria: Oof. I saw some blips in CI perf dash last night but didn't dig in. Which kernel pick change is suspected?

alex: The autotuner now prefers the paged-kv block-size=128 path on A100 for MQA when seqlen>1024. Before it picked block-size=64 + larger warp kernels.

jin: I ran a microbench with the same commit. Rough numbers (single-stream, cold cache, 2048):
```
before: p95=32.4ms p99=48.1ms
after:  p95=36.0ms p99=56.8ms
```
Seems KV cache prefetching interacts badly with the new blocksz.

benchbot: Automated profile attached: kernel_switch_count: 1200 -> 3100, avg_kernel_launch_ms: 0.41 -> 0.63, kv_page_loads_up: +42%.

sam: Can you dump perf counters? my hunch is increased L1/SMEM thrash due to different stripe layout when block-size grows.

maria: I instrumented cache lines and saw higher conflict misses in the paged layout when pagesize=128. Raw counters: L1_miss_rate 0.18 -> 0.27, shared_mem_bank_conflicts +37%.

jin: Also noticed that batching heuristics changed: the scheduler groups shorter requests into larger continuous batches which amplify the longer-kernel path. Might be compounding.

alex: Ok. Action plan options: 1) revert tuner for A100-MQA to prefer block=64 for seqlen>1024; 2) add a regression guard that keeps previous kernel if p99 worsens during canary; 3) tune prefetch thresholds for paged-kv. Thoughts?

sam: +2 for regression guard. We should avoid unilateral autotuner flips without canary validation. Also try prefetch tuning in parallel.

maria: I'll open a small PR to add the canary check (metrics: p95 and p99 over 1k requests in CI harness). Drafting now.

jin: I'll run a focused sweep: blocksz {64,96,128} x prefetch {0.5,1.0,1.5} on A100 and report heatmap. Expect results in ~3 hours.

ops-bot: Note: deploy v3-autotune to staging at 2026-03-17T10:14Z — canary enabled=false by default.

alex: Thanks. If jin's sweep shows 64 still best for seqlen>1024, we'll patch tuner rule; otherwise tweak prefetch. Keep replies short — want clear next-step before EOD. :thumbsup:

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4310 — adds canary gating, tests, and revert flag.

jin: Sweep results: block=64 + prefetch=1.0 is best p99; block=128 only helps throughput at lower seqlen but kills p99 for 2048. I'll attach CSV to the PR.

alex: Great. Maria — let's merge the canary guard and enable it for A100-MQA with default favoring block=64. Sam/jin coordinate prefetch follow-ups. We'll monitor telemetry next 24h.

sam: On it. I'll set temporary alert for p99 drift +5% on eng/runtime model routes.

benchbot: Canary merged to staging, alerting rule created.

alex: Perfect. Postmortem if it reappears, but closing thread for now. Ping if anything else crops up. :rocket:
